items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: And Margie had Jessica Amat. You see, Margie was brand new. So, well, I don't like to play with the melody, but I'd blow the devil out of Margie all day.

ctx.x: Well, you say you enjoy playing with all bands. Do you enjoy playing with all the different bands around town now that you work with the same? Well, yeah, I enjoy it. You just as soon played with the band at the paddock as with Kid Thomas, say, or Percy? Yeah. You notice any difference between the bands? No.
No. Well, it's just that some bands will have a better tempo than others. Whoa. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

I don't know if I'm a good man. What about Bush Hall? I want to get more about that band. Who was in that? Do you remember anything? No, I don't remember. I just used to see him nine dead. Another thing I wanted to ask you was, you were telling Russell about going out with Mardi Gras and playing alone in the streets just you on the clarinet when you were young?
